overview: A one-page “List of Papers” index sheet for State Department file 894A.512, concerning taxation in Taiwan. It records a 1937 report from Taihoku to the U.S. Embassy in Tokyo, associated with Warner, about increased taxes imposed by the Taihoku Tax Office on the Anglo-American Direct Tea Trading Co.; the underlying report itself is not included in the surviving text.

people.name: Warner
people.role: Correspondent associated with the 1937 report from Taihoku to the U.S. Embassy in Tokyo

subfiles.title: List of Papers entry on taxes imposed on Anglo-American tea company
subfiles.about: An index entry records a report concerning increased taxes levied by the Taihoku Tax Office on the Anglo-American Direct Tea Trading Co.
subfiles.summary: This filing sheet identifies the subject as taxation in Taiwan. It references a 1937 communication from Taihoku to the U.S. Embassy in Tokyo, associated with Warner, reporting increased taxes imposed on the Anglo-American Direct Tea Trading Co. The underlying communication is not reproduced on this page.

interest: Although only an index sheet, the document points to a potentially valuable case study of Japanese colonial taxation in Taiwan and its effects on Anglo-American commercial interests. It also preserves the archival trail—origin, destination, correspondent, year, and subject—needed to locate or reconstruct a missing report on the treatment of a foreign tea-trading company.
